name: steam-and-frost-concept
description: Concept landing page for a takeaway hot & cold beverage shop (Arabic-first, RTL). Demo content only.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:share: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode share && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs dist-share share/steam-and-frost.html
